subject: general
question: Let X ~ N(μ, σ²), then the fourth central moment of X is:
solution:
The correct answer is **3σ4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The fourth central moment of a normal distribution (also known as kurtosis) is defined as the expectation of the fourth power of the deviations from the mean, divided by the standard deviation to the fourth power.
